input.name: features
input.description: 10 keypoint-derived geometric features computed from one person's YOLOv8-Pose 17-keypoint output + bbox. See scripts/features.py::extract_features for the exact computation and scripts/features.py::FEATURE_NAMES for the order.
input.preprocessing: Standardize each feature with (x - feature_mean[i]) / feature_std[i] BEFORE calling the model. feature_mean/feature_std are the train-set statistics saved in fall_classifier_v1.pt (also duplicated below for convenience) - do NOT refit these at inference time.

output.name: fall_probability
output.description: P(fall) in [0, 1]. Already through sigmoid - no further transform needed.
